{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module AuthService where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BC
import qualified Crypto.Hash as H
import qualified Data.ByteArray as BA
import Data.ByteArray (constEq)
import Data.Word (Word8)
import Data.IORef
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime, UTCTime, diffUTCTime)
import Control.Monad (when, unless)

-- Configuration for the authentication service
data AuthConfig = AuthConfig
  { acSecretKey    :: BS.ByteString
  , acHashTruncLen :: Int  -- how many bytes of the hash to compare (for bandwidth savings)
  , acMaxTokenAge  :: Int  -- seconds
  , acAlgorithm    :: String
  } deriving (Show)

-- Parse configuration from key-value pairs
parseConfig :: Map.Map String String -> Either String AuthConfig
parseConfig kvs = do
  let secret = BC.pack $ fromMaybe "" $ Map.lookup "secret" kvs
  when (BS.length secret < 16) $ Left "Secret key too short"
  
  let truncStr = fromMaybe "32" $ Map.lookup "hash_truncation_bytes" kvs
  truncLen <- case reads truncStr of
    [(n, "")] -> validateTruncLen n
    _         -> Left "Invalid truncation length"
  
  let maxAge = read $ fromMaybe "3600" $ Map.lookup "max_token_age" kvs
  let algo = fromMaybe "SHA256" $ Map.lookup "algorithm" kvs
  
  return $ AuthConfig secret truncLen maxAge algo

-- Validate truncation length is within acceptable bounds
-- SHA-256 produces 32 bytes, so truncation must be in [1, 32]
validateTruncLen :: Int -> Either String Int
validateTruncLen n
  | n < 0     = Left "Truncation length must be positive"
  | n > 32    = Left "Truncation length exceeds hash size"
  | otherwise = Right n

-- Compute HMAC-SHA256 (simplified but using real crypto primitives)
computeMAC :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
computeMAC key msg =
  let ipad = BS.map (\b -> b `xor` 0x36) (padKey key)
      opad = BS.map (\b -> b `xor` 0x5c) (padKey key)
      innerHash = hashSHA256 (ipad `BS.append` msg)
      outerHash = hashSHA256 (opad `BS.append` innerHash)
  in outerHash
  where
    xor a b = a `BA.xor` b  -- this won't compile as-is, use Data.Bits

-- Actually use proper crypto
computeMAC' :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
computeMAC' key msg = BA.convert digest
  where
    digest :: H.Digest H.SHA256
    digest = H.hashFinalize $ H.hashUpdate (H.hashUpdate (H.hashInitWith H.SHA256) key) msg

hashSHA256 :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
hashSHA256 bs = BA.convert (H.hash bs :: H.Digest H.SHA256)

padKey :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
padKey k
  | BS.length k > 64 = hashSHA256 k `BS.append` BS.replicate (64 - 32) 0
  | BS.length k < 64 = k `BS.append` BS.replicate (64 - BS.length k) 0
  | otherwise = k

-- Truncate hash to configured length for comparison
truncateHash :: Int -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
truncateHash len h = BS.take len h

-- Verify a token's MAC
-- Token format: <payload>.<mac_hex>
verifyToken :: AuthConfig -> BS.ByteString -> Bool
verifyToken cfg token =
  case BC.split '.' token of
    [payload, providedMacHex] ->
      let expectedFull = computeMAC' (acSecretKey cfg) payload
          expectedTrunc = truncateHash (acHashTruncLen cfg) expectedFull
          providedMac = hexDecode providedMacHex
          providedTrunc = truncateHash (acHashTruncLen cfg) providedMac
      in constantTimeEq expectedTrunc providedTrunc
    _ -> False

-- Constant-time equality check
constantTimeEq :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> Bool
constantTimeEq a b
  | BS.length a /= BS.length b = False
  | otherwise = BA.constEq a b

-- Hex decoding
hexDecode :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
hexDecode hex = BS.pack $ go (BS.unpack hex)
  where
    go [] = []
    go [_] = []  -- odd length, ignore last nibble
    go (h:l:rest) = (hexVal h * 16 + hexVal l) : go rest
    hexVal w
      | w >= 48 && w <= 57  = w - 48
      | w >= 65 && w <= 70  = w - 55
      | w >= 97 && w <= 102 = w - 87
      | otherwise = 0

-- Session management
data Session = Session
  { sessUser    :: String
  , sessCreated :: UTCTime
  , sessData    :: Map.Map String String
  } deriving (Show)

{-# NOINLINE sessionStore #-}
sessionStore :: IORef (Map.Map BS.ByteString Session)
sessionStore = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef Map.empty

{-# NOINLINE configRef #-}
configRef :: IORef AuthConfig
configRef = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef $ AuthConfig
  { acSecretKey = "default-key-change-me-in-prod!!"
  , acHashTruncLen = 32
  , acMaxTokenAge = 3600
  , acAlgorithm = "SHA256"
  }

-- Update configuration (e.g., from admin endpoint)
updateConfig :: Map.Map String String -> IO (Either String ())
updateConfig kvs = do
  case parseConfig kvs of
    Left err -> return $ Left err
    Right cfg -> do
      writeIORef configRef cfg
      return $ Right ()

-- Authenticate a request
authenticateRequest :: BS.ByteString -> IO Bool
authenticateRequest token = do
  cfg <- readIORef configRef
  return $ verifyToken cfg token

-- Create a signed token
createToken :: BS.ByteString -> IO BS.ByteString
createToken payload = do
  cfg <- readIORef configRef
  let mac = computeMAC' (acSecretKey cfg) payload
      truncMac = truncateHash (acHashTruncLen cfg) mac
  return $ payload `BS.append` BC.pack "." `BS.append` hexEncode truncMac

hexEncode :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
hexEncode = BC.pack . concatMap (\w -> [hexChar (w `div` 16), hexChar (w `mod` 16)]) . BS.unpack
  where
    hexChar n
      | n < 10    = toEnum (fromEnum '0' + fromIntegral n)
      | otherwise = toEnum (fromEnum 'a' + fromIntegral n - 10)
